easyPrerequisites:
You control another Elf.
You are able to play a land this turn
description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Warp Speed, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Thranduil's Company.
Because of the additional Thranduil's Company token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
